source.note: the SECOND token→sac argument-cover witness (corroborates Chatterfang's E4 on the card-type branch): a created CREATURE token's at-creation card type provably COVERS a generic 'sacrifice a creature' cost. A one-shot fodder-feeds-outlet value pairwise, NOT a loop. No CSB/popularity row for this pairing in dumps/combo-instances.json, so no source.popularity.

judge.ref: ij 2026-07-17 b7 — token->sac GREEN (creature-token covers creature-sac, CR 111.10/205.3); redundant sibling collapsed to base-rule reference; PROCEED

Ophiomancer.note: 'create a 1/1 black Snake creature token with deathtouch' (AST port emit:token:creature:snake:controlled). The token's at-creation card type is creature (CR 111.10 — a created token's types are fully specified at creation); Snake also rides creature (CR 205.3). Upkeep-gated 'if you control no Snakes' is a timing/board condition on HOW OFTEN the token appears — orthogonal to the type-cover, and irrelevant to a pairwise (no SDF/loop tiering). Deathtouch grant not modeled (not part of the cover).

Nantuko Husk.note: the sac cost 'Sacrifice a creature' (AST port sac:creature:controlled, isSelf=false). A type-based, controlled creature argument — NOT :self — so it is refuellable by an externally-created creature (TokenSatisfiesAtCreation's not-self positive branch, CR 400.7).
'This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn' — the outlet's payoff; not on the witnessed edge.

notes: Ophiomancer's Snake token is at-creation a creature (card type creature, explicit in the token emit; Snake also rides creature via CR 205.3). Husk's argument-consume requires 'a creature' (card type creature, no subtype). creature COVERS creature (cover, not intersect — the §6 argument-cost semantics, CR 601.2b) → GREEN. Reuses the confirmed policy:argument:subject-cover; the co-declared card-type branch corroborates it. Not a :self consume → TokenSatisfiesAtCreation refuel holds. The argument-side analogue of Ruthless×Blood's subscription-side creature⊆creature GREEN.

assertions.because: creature-token at-creation card type COVERS the 'sacrifice a creature' argument (creature ⊆ creature, no subtype straddle)
reuses the confirmed argument-cover rule (a reference, not a re-declaration); the co-declared card-type branch carries the corroborates pointer
unit=pairwise: a one-shot fodder-feeds-outlet value pairwise (Ophiomancer refills at most one Snake per upkeep), not a repeating cycle — no §10 SDF balance
